notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
description:
During your draw step, before you draw a card, activate Words of Worship by paying {1}, causing you to gain five life the next time you would draw a card this turn.
Move to draw a card, instead gaining five life due to Words of Worship.
Lich's Mastery's first ability triggers, holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Activate Words of Worship by paying {1}, causing you to gain five life the next time you would draw a card this turn.
Resolve Lich's Mastery, causing you to draw four cards and gain five life.
Repeat from step 3.
